qt.title: Some Words to Say
qt.perface: QQ Tang and Bubble Tang took up a big part of our childhood. There, we gained a great deal of joy and laughter, and of course anger and helplessness as well. We watched them grow step by step, mature, and reach their peak, and then watched them become overrun by cheats and slowly decline. Even now, most people who still play these two games are no longer simply playing the games themselves, but the nostalgia behind them. Bubble Tang is still manageable, but QQ Tang has now even reached the point where you may need to install a virtual machine just to play it. While playing, besides reliving the fun of those years, we can also faintly feel the possibility that the servers may shut down at any time. Therefore, I am collecting some QT materials here, so that if the game ever closes, you can still come here and remember that there was once such a beautiful part of our past........
qt.copyright: For the record, the materials on this website are all collected from the internet. If anything involves infringement or is not allowed to be reposted, please contact the author for removal.

tt.name: Titan
tt.introduce: He returned from the future to the present through a mysterious time tunnel. In the future world, he has a fine name: Titan. Titan was enchanted by the peaceful, beautiful Candy Kingdom full of natural charm. Ancient trees spread their shade everywhere, colorful wildflowers bloomed all around, and bees and butterflies danced among the leaves and blossoms. Titan had never experienced any of this in the future world. In that future human society, however, the harmony of nature had been completely destroyed by reckless destruction. Forests of steel and concrete replaced lush primeval woods, excessive exploitation of natural resources caused sewage to flow everywhere and poison to spread, and the environment became extremely harsh. Humans could barely survive only by combining themselves with machines, and the beautiful world was thoroughly changed by humanity itself. Yet the legend of the Fantastical QQ Candy continued into the future. After learning that it could make dreams come true, the young Titan resolutely came back to the present through the time tunnel. He hopes to find the legendary Fantastical QQ Candy during his limited journey and bring it back to the future, using its magic to turn the future world into a paradise for humankind once again. Perhaps no one in the QQ Candy Kingdom knows Titan, and not even Elder Shulan can guess his story, but that does not matter to him. Although the weight of machinery makes him move a little slowly, his tremendous power and inborn double-shot QQ Candy give Titan every reason to believe that this journey will not be in vain.

wk.name: Little Wukong
wk.introduce: The Candy Kingdom is a fairy-tale world made up of many beautiful islands. To the east of the kingdom lies a place called Flower-Fruit Island. One clear summer noon, a sudden bolt of lightning tore across the sky and split a huge stone in the center of the island into two. After seeing this, the well-traveled Elder Shulan declared that something extraordinary was bound to happen there. Sure enough, the residents who rushed over found a tiny monkey inside the cracked stone. It turned out to be the Nth-generation descendant of the Great Sage Sun Wukong. Because the stone monkey was so small, people called him Little Wukong. A young couple from the Candy Kingdom took him in, and Little Wukong slowly grew up in the Candy Castle. In the Candy Kingdom there is a long-standing tradition: when a child can make their own little QQ Candy, they are allowed to adventure throughout the kingdom. Little Wukong was gentle by nature and grew up playing with the kingdom's children, and Little Shrimp became his best friend. A few years later, when Little Shrimp tried to make his first QQ Candy, Little Wukong began to feel sad, because he finally realized that the friends around him were growing up day by day while he was still only a tiny monkey. He remembered Elder Shulan once joking that if one day Little Wukong could grow into a big monkey, he could roam the world and uphold justice just like his ancestor, the Great Sage. Therefore, growing up quickly and becoming the true Great Sage has become Little Wukong's greatest dream.

xq.name: Xiao Qian
xq.introduce: Who says demons must be bad? Xiao Qian, the fox spirit living deep in the mountains, is a genuinely good demon. She loves the way people live in the QQ Candy Kingdom and has always longed to become one of its happy members. But being born a fox spirit made that dream impossible to achieve. In order to become a real human, Xiao Qian once naively believed that as long as she accumulated good deeds and cultivated herself for a thousand years, her wish would come true. And so people began to notice that children who got lost would always return home safely, gravely ill elders would often find rare mountain herbs at their doors that even doctors had never heard of, and insomniacs would fall asleep peacefully at night to faint yet beautiful songs drifting through the air... In the whole kingdom, only Elder Shulan knew of Xiao Qian's efforts, yet she still often heard the elder sigh softly. Finally, one day, Xiao Qian came to understand that no matter how profound her cultivation was, she could never turn herself into an ordinary human. So, holding on to one last hope, she used her magic to carry more QQ Candy than others and joined the team searching for the Fantastical QQ Candy. As a kind fox spirit, Xiao Qian's greatest dream is to use the magic of the Fantastical QQ Candy to become a member of the Candy Kingdom, a true and kind human being.

cl.name: Chun Li
cl.introduce: Chinese kung fu has been famous throughout the world since ancient times, and the QQ Candy Kingdom is no exception. Ever since she was old enough to understand things, the little girl Chun Li has studied Chinese martial arts under her grandfather, Master Roshi. Master Roshi was originally a wandering Chinese warrior. After drifting into the QQ Candy Kingdom and seeing the kingdom's peace and prosperity, he decided to stay there. Chun Li, a little girl whom he had taken in during his travels, also settled in the Candy Castle with him. Master Roshi was known by everyone in the kingdom, especially for his powerful Turtle Wave technique and extraordinary fighting skills. But he also had a troublesome weakness: he loved alcohol more than life itself. The gourd he always carried with him seemed to contain endless vintage liquor. During the holy war when the demons invaded, his Turtle Wave combined perfectly with QQ Candy and greatly helped the people of the Candy Kingdom, making him a hero in everyone's eyes. Chun Li grew up fascinated by her grandfather's glorious stories. She loves Chinese martial arts, and no matter how many difficulties she met on the road of practice, she never gave up. Under Master Roshi's careful guidance, her fighting skills improved by leaps and bounds. By the time Chun Li made her first little QQ Candy, she had already become the fiercest female fighter in the Candy Kingdom. But fate always seems to test people when life is going well. Master Roshi, who often drank himself senseless, suddenly disappeared. Because it happened so suddenly, even the elder could not explain it. Worried and anxious, Chun Li searched almost every corner of the Candy Kingdom with everyone else, but still found nothing. As time passed, she became more and more concerned for her grandfather's safety. At the end of her rope, Chun Li suddenly remembered the ancient legend of the Fantastical QQ Candy. So the little girl set out without hesitation on a journey to find it, swearing that no matter the cost, she would find her beloved grandfather. Thanks to the Turtle Wave and divine footwork her grandfather taught her, Chun Li has already reached a high level in both movement speed and the power of her QQ Candy. But after all, this is the first time a young girl has traveled so far alone. What will the result be?

bbl.name: Boboli
bbl.introduce: Many people have heard the fairy tale of Cinderella, and Boboli, an ordinary girl of the Candy Kingdom, is the Cinderella of this fairy-tale land. Boboli is so plain and unremarkable: ordinary features, an unremarkable voice, no bright and exquisite dresses, and she even seems to do everything half a beat slower than others. Any stranger would completely forget this overly ordinary girl as soon as they turned away. But like all innocent children, Boboli is deeply fascinated by beautiful fairy tales, especially the legend of Cinderella, which she can never forget. Perhaps because her own plainness resembles Cinderella's in some ways, Boboli often sits alone by the sea with her head propped on both hands, gazing at the vast, deep ocean and imagining that one day she could become a beautiful princess, with a magnificent carriage bringing her beloved prince to fetch her, and together they would attend a dreamy ball and receive endless blessings full of envy... When a cargo ship bound for distant lands slowly left the harbor, Boboli set out with the broom that was said to bring her good luck. She is going to search for the legendary sacred object, the Fantastical QQ Candy, because with it she can become a true Cinderella...

hy.name: Fire Shadow
hy.introduce: Fire Shadow, who has practiced the mysteries of ninjutsu since childhood, was appointed by the king as a royal guard of the Candy Court because of his superb martial skills and upright character. He leads a team of ninja soldiers and is always ready to carry out whatever tasks the king assigns. Fire Shadow is introverted and speaks very little. In his view, a qualified ninja should be good at thinking rather than talking endlessly. Since the holy war ended long ago, people's lives have long been peaceful and tranquil. As a result, the ninja unit's missions have become very rare, and the importance of ninjas has gradually been forgotten by people living in peace. This pains Fire Shadow deeply. When fewer and fewer people were willing to study ninjutsu and the ancient martial arts faced the threat of being lost, the usually silent Fire Shadow finally erupted. He could no longer stand by and watch the martial art he loved disappear little by little. After receiving the understanding and permission of the king and Elder Shulan, Fire Shadow vanished silently from the palace. His extraordinary agility will help him search for the Fantastical QQ Candy. No one is faster than he is, and no one understands the essence of ninjutsu better. Fire Shadow wants to use ninjutsu to find the national treasure, prove the strength of ninjas, and use the magic of the Fantastical QQ Candy to carry forward the art he has mastered throughout the Candy Kingdom.

mly.name: Maria
mly.introduce: Maria is a nun of the royal church in the Candy Kingdom. The most important thing she does every day is pray for the happiness of all the people with her pure heart. Nuns are a respected and beloved calling in the Candy Kingdom. People have always believed in the existence and protection of the gods, and nuns are the messengers between mortals and the divine. However, at some point, rumors about Maria's background began to spread through the kingdom. People learned that she was a descendant of Aiden, the Demon King from the Holy War Against Evil. For the war-weary people of the kingdom, it was impossible to accept that the child of a demon could become a holy nun. They believed that Maria was a curse left by the demons in the kingdom and that she might at any time summon the remaining evil power to destroy the beautiful Candy Kingdom again. As a result, Maria began to suffer rejection and accusations from the people. In pain, she confirmed her identity from Elder Shulan, who kindly also told her that she had inherited none of the demons' beliefs. Having grown up in the church, her soul had instead been purified by faith in the gods. But rumors and prejudice are terrifying forces, and the kind, simple people still could not believe in the innocence of a demon's descendant. Maria struggled on the edge between affirmation and denial. To prove her innocence to the people she loves, she could only place her hopes in the power of the Fantastical QQ Candy. Carrying with her the sighs and blessings of the gods, Maria gained power beyond ordinary people, and her devout and holy heart will remain with her throughout her journey of adventure.

hwz.name: Sea Prince
hwz.introduce: On the vast seas surrounding the QQ Candy Kingdom, there exists a strange pirate fleet. They are unlike ordinary pirates. This so-called nameless fleet never attacks common cargo ships or fishermen. Yet whenever the ships of greedy nobles put to sea, they always seem to be completely plundered. Whenever a noble ship is attacked by pirates, part of the stolen wealth soon appears in the hands of kind commoners. People gradually came to realize that the nameless fleet was made up of righteous pirates, and robbing the rich to help the poor was their consistent way. So while greedy nobles were troubled because they no longer dared to sail, ordinary people often prayed for the pirates' safety whenever storms came. Who exactly leads such a mysterious pirate fleet? No one knows. When the pirate captain's only son was born, the nameless fleet was rescuing helpless fishing boats in the midst of a storm. The baby's cry seemed to possess divine power, driving away the terrible tempest, and the whole sea suddenly began to sparkle. When the safely returned fishermen spread the news that a baby's crying had been heard on the pirate ship, people began to speculate about the child's identity and respectfully called him the Sea Prince. The Sea Prince grew up aboard pirate ships. Under his father's guidance, he learned to swim, sail, and work as a sailor. He was exceptionally gifted and quick to learn from an early age. Moreover, for some unknown reason, not long after he became sensible, he had already mastered the extraordinary skill of making top-grade QQ Candy. His natural intelligence soon made him an excellent young would-be captain. Every time they went to sea, whether attacking noble fleets or rescuing ships in distress, the Sea Prince could brilliantly command and assist everyone in completing the mission. In many cases, his talent even surpassed that of his father. The Pirate King was always immensely proud of his outstanding prince, but whenever the Sea Prince asked why his father had become a pirate, the only answer he received was a meaningful sigh. Time passed like a swift ship with a fair wind, and the Sea Prince welcomed the rite of adulthood at sixteen, which also meant he would be qualified to own a small ship of his own. The sailboat called 'Little Prince' was the Pirate King's birthday gift to him. It was also on this day that the Sea Prince finally learned from his father the reason he had become a pirate. Now grown, and carrying youthful passion and excitement, he secretly sailed the 'Little Prince' into the distance under cover of night without the Pirate King's permission. At this moment, the Sea Prince firmly believes that he has grown up and now has enough strength to unravel the knot of his father's past. His many years of drifting through the world have led him, like many others, to firmly believe in the existence of the Fantastical QQ Candy. The goal of this journey is to obtain it, reveal to the world the truth behind the Pirate King's identity, return to their homeland with his father, and put an end to the humiliating life of piracy.

yd.name: Yidan
yd.introduce: Raised in the Kingdom of Nature and yearning for the beautiful power of nature, Yidan is agile, nimble, and kind-hearted. In the Realm of Nature he met Duoji, and through a comical fight the two came to know each other and became good friends.

kls.name: Kris
kls.introduce: Kris is the daughter of Lanning, a light mage of the Magic Kingdom. She is lively, cheerful, and carries a bit of mischievous spirit. One day, when her father was suddenly bewitched by dark magic and kept sinking deeper into corruption, the clever Kris chose to leave. She began traveling the world, urgently searching for companions who could help her save her fallen father.

dj.name: Duoji
dj.introduce: Duoji is a warrior of the Kazad mountain tribe who loves a life of travel and adventure. While in the Kingdom of Nature, he met Princess Kris. After learning about the plight of her homeland, the Magic Kingdom, he decided to help the princess save the kingdom in crisis.

tb.name: Taibi
tb.introduce: Taibi is a light magic mentor of the Magic Kingdom and also Kris's teacher. When the kingdom was taken over by Aiden, the Child of Darkness, he fought against the darkness while protecting Kris and helping her escape.

xz.name: Xingzai
xz.introduce: Xingzai was originally a down-and-out street thug. To make a living, he came to Pigsty Alley hoping to rob the residents, but he never expected these seemingly ordinary townspeople to each possess extraordinary martial arts skills. Not only did he fail to get any money, he also drew the attention of the Axe Gang, triggering a great showdown between righteous and evil forces in Pigsty Alley.

cbz.name: Veggie Bun
cbz.introduce: Veggie Bun is also a light magic mentor of the Magic Kingdom and one of Kris's teachers. When the kingdom was controlled by Aiden, the Child of Darkness, he resisted the darkness while protecting Kris and helping her escape.

xxm.name: Little Shrimp
xxm.introduce: Little Shrimp is just an ordinary little boy in the QQ Candy Kingdom, as ordinary as his name suggests. Since childhood, he has loved listening to Elder Shulan's stories. The naive Little Shrimp was always inspired by the warriors in the Holy War who defeated demons with QQ Candy. Becoming a brave and respected candy hero has always been his persistent dream. While many children were used to acting spoiled under the care of their families, Little Shrimp liked exploring the wilderness with his best friend Little Wukong. Through the trials of climbing mountains, crossing rivers, and venturing out to sea, he gained more experience and courage than ordinary children, and unknowingly awakened the potential within himself. As a result, when the time was right, he could carry more QQ Candy than most people and run faster than they could. When the first tiny QQ Candy named after Little Shrimp was finally made, he was at last able to set out properly for distant places and continue the adventures he loved. Of course, searching for the legendary Fantastical QQ Candy to fulfill his dream of becoming a candy hero is the main reason Little Shrimp decided to travel far from home. Packing his simple luggage, Little Shrimp set off with his inseparable good friend Little Wukong on a journey to find the Fantastical QQ Candy...

jwz.name: Prince Jie
jwz.introduce: When the superstar with unmatched charm and golden armor appears in QQT, he brings you an even cuter character design, a richer gameplay experience, and the feeling of personally recreating the film. Jay transforms into the Golden BOSS. To become the final hero, you must defeat him. Can you do it? Let's see who is truly the ruler of Golden City.

kl.name: Cola
kl.introduce: Cola is the lead guitarist of the Sweet Ai Band. His real identity is 'Screw', and he grew up with Titan in Hammer Town as a close friend. He shares the same ambition and determination as Titan. But after losing in his rivalry with Titan, the deeply disappointed Cola turned and took a stand against everyone else...

nz.name: Nezha
nz.introduce: Nezha is the lead singer of the Sweet Ai Band. Her true identity is actually 'Killer Yi'. She may look somewhat delicate and gentle on the outside, but in reality she is the most capable assistant by Cola's side. Although she is usually quiet and taciturn, during band performances she becomes wildly different from her normal self. Her specialty lies in using her quiet and cute appearance to lower an enemy's guard, then suddenly exploding into action and delivering a crushing blow...

wll.name: Ulala
wll.introduce: She sells ice cream at the amusement park in Candy Town and was launched together with the Sokoban game mode. Her family has a farm and cows, so making creamy ice cream is convenient for her. She wants to go have fun at the amusement park, so she sells ice cream to earn some money. She only sells strawberry milk ice cream, and it's actually pretty good, because she loves it.

yy.name: Yaya
yy.introduce: Yaya is the village chief's daughter in Candy Town, a willful young lady. Although she looks cute on the outside, she is actually quite spoiled, looks down on poor people, thinks she is clever, believes she is very fashionable, and keeps doing silly things. Her history of foolish incidents includes: 1. During the Chinese martial arts tournament, she fell asleep in the lounge during the competition and ended up missing the whole event. 2. During the summer zombie event, she inhaled poison gas while searching for zombies and wandered aimlessly through zombie territory in a daze, not finding her way out until after the Zombie King had already been defeated. 3. During Titan's return, she secretly went to Mechanical City and got stuck inside a spaceship, and had to be rescued in the end.

mm.name: Maomao
mm.introduce: With a mischievous grin on his face, Maomao loves pranks most of all. Stuffing caterpillars into girls' schoolbags and snapping all the teacher's chalk are things he often does. But don't think Maomao is a bad child. He often helps others too, only... he does it quietly. He likes hearing people call him a 'bad kid', because that sounds cool to him.

as.name: Asha
as.introduce: Asha usually appears as a well-behaved girl, but deep inside she longs for adventure. The stories of the sugar maker Berank fascinate her the most, and she dreams that one day she too can become a great sugar maker. With that wish in her heart, Asha joined the big family of QQ Tang, so don't underestimate her just because she is new. The fairy-tale kingdom full of mystery has already closed. A world made of candy, candy street lamps, palaces built of candy... people called that former world the QQ Candy Castle. It is said that the residents of Candy Castle have for generations taken joy in making candy and could produce the most interesting and lovable sweets. Among hundreds of kinds of candy, QQ Candy was recognized as the finest. QQ Candy looked like a crystal ball filled with clear water, shining with a breathtaking seven-colored halo. But now, people can no longer make QQ Candy, and the traditional competitions of using QQ Candy against each other have also come to an end. Still, people will never forget the wonderful matches of the past. When the innocent descendants of those children are born, we, who were once innocent children ourselves, will also tell them about those classic competitions...

list.name: Normal
list.desc: The most basic gameplay mode. Use arrow keys to move and press Space to place Sugar Bubbles. Sugar Bubbles explode into syrup after 5 seconds in a cross pattern. The syrup can trap opponents, destroy bricks, and reveal power-ups that greatly enhance your abilities. If you're trapped by syrup, you can't move and will be eliminated after 5 seconds. A teammate can rescue you by touching you, but if an opponent touches you, you're eliminated immediately. When all members of your team are eliminated, your team loses. Practice more, and you'll become a true master!

list.name: Box Pushing
list.desc: Box Pushing is very different from Normal mode. Players don't place Sugar Bubbles—instead, push boxes to hit opponents while avoiding boxes charging toward you. Hold arrow keys to push boxes one tile at a time. Press Space to smash the box in front of you. Press Space + arrow key together to launch a box forward. Each player starts with 4 HP. Being hit by a box or flames reduces 1 HP. The player who survives until the end wins.

list.name: Treasure Hunt
list.desc: Treasure Hunt is based on Normal mode, but treasure chests may explode and reveal gems. Touch a gem to collect it, and your current gem count will show in the character panel. If knocked out, you respawn after 10 seconds. When knocked out, your collected gems scatter across the map. The team that collects all gems first, or has the most gems when time runs out, wins.

list.name: Duel
list.desc: Duel mode is similar to Normal mode—arrow keys to move, Space to place Sugar Bubbles. The difference: when knocked out, you don't lose immediately but revive after a short time. Each time you defeat an opponent, your record increases by 1. The team with the highest total kills wins.

list.name: Baozi Grab
list.desc: Baozi Grab adds team cooperation to Normal mode. Players are divided into two teams, each with their own base. When hit by Sugar Bubbles, you can be knocked out but recover after 10 seconds. Enter the enemy base to carry out one baozi, but your movement slows and you can't place Sugar Bubbles while carrying it. When you bring an enemy baozi to your base, your base gains one more baozi. The team with the most baozi when time ends wins.

list.name: Mecha World
list.desc: Mecha World differs significantly from Normal mode, but basic controls are the same: arrow keys to move, Space to place Sugar Bubbles. In Mecha World, Sugar Bubbles are thrown farther, and there's always an impassable river splitting the map. Players have 4 HP. Each Sugar Bubble hit reduces 1 HP. When HP reaches 0, you're knocked out. Only the team that survives to the end wins. Legend says pressing arrow keys and Space in certain patterns unleashes powerful special moves!

list.name: Hero Legend
list.desc: Hero Legend is based on Normal mode, but players must collect statues and bring them to their base. Statues explode from special bricks on the map. If knocked out by a Sugar Bubble, you respawn after 5 seconds. Touch a statue and bring it back to your base to make it grow taller. The first player to complete their base's growth wins.

list.name: Soccer
list.desc: Soccer is a special mode where players can't place Sugar Bubbles or perform other actions—only use arrow keys to dodge. Quick reflexes are key to victory. In Soccer mode, automatically dropped Sugar Bubbles become increasingly numerous!

list.name: Tangker Battle
list.desc: Tangker Battle debuted in QQ Tang 3.2 Polar Adventure as Tencent's new creative feature. Different from other competitive maps, it shares similarities with Baozi Grab. Victory condition: eliminate all opposing players so they can't revive (by destroying their base). If neither side wins when time ends, it's a draw. Items: Wrench restores 30 HP to base; Turtle Shell lets you hide and block one explosion (can't move while inside, shell disappears when you move); Armor reduces base damage by 50% for 10 seconds.

list.name: Adventure
list.desc: Adventure mode differs from Competitive modes—it's players vs. monsters and bosses. Players don't attack each other; instead, cooperate to defeat monsters. Before the game, equip items to help defeat monsters. Defeating monsters or destroying bricks may yield materials to craft items. Place Sugar Bubbles to attack monsters. When a monster's HP reaches 0, it's knocked out. Players also have HP and die when it reaches 0. As adventure levels increase, your HP increases too. Keep going and defeat the monsters!
